response.original_title: [Upgrade-Guide] How to Upgrade Your Cabin on a Crystal Cruise?
response.overview: Upgrading your cabin on a Crystal Cruises booking can be done by contacting customer service +1-866-254-7549 or your travel advisor to pay the current price difference +1-866-254-7549, or by participating in an eligible bid-based upgrade program.Ways to Upgrade Direct Purchase: Call Crystal's reservation team at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or your travel advisor to check availability and pay the prevailing fare difference for a higher-category stateroom +1-866-254-7549. If you booked through a travel agency +1-866-254-7549, your agent must handle the modification for you. Bid-Based Program: Eligible guests may receive invitations or access a Manage Reservation portal to place a blind bid or offer for an available higher category +1-866-254-7549.  Onboard or Port Requests: Same-day, port, or onboard upgrades are extremely limited and rarely accommodated +1-866-254-7549, so arranging changes well before your sail date is strongly recommended.
